question: What pervasiveness and manifesting power are claimed for the deity in this salutation?
premises: The deity is addressed as all-pervading.
The deity is addressed as manifester of colors.
inference: The deity is all-pervading and manifests colors or classes.
uncertainties: varṇa may mean color or social class.
plain_english: Obeisance to the all-pervading one, obeisance to the manifester of colors.
